candidate_relations.reason: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium-sized pleomorphic T-cell lymphoma is a distinct WHO/EORTC entity from mycosis fungoides. Although the histology shows CD4+ small-to-medium atypical cells, the 12-year history of ichthyosiform patches, epidermotropism, and clonal TCR γ-chain rearrangement in the context of longstanding skin disease is characteristic of MF, not this separate entity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different primary cutaneous T-cell lymphoma entity; incompatible with MF diagnosis

candidate_relations.reason: Labeling this as 'classic' MF explicitly assigns the Alibert-Bazin patch-plaque-tumor subtype, which is a different clinical variant from ichthyosiform MF. The ichthyosiform presentation (dry scaly patches resembling ichthyosis) is a recognized distinct variant, so 'classic' is an incompatible subtype designation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Specifies classic (Alibert-Bazin) MF subtype, which conflicts with the ichthyosiform variant
